name: Chapter Master Aureus Erinyes
text:
Uncompromising. Stern. Inevitable. Many words have been used to describe the Chapter Master of the Absolvers during his long life, but few have come close to encompassing the reality. It was he who stood at the precipice of the Ermine Gates and, in the face of almost certain death and likely damnation, led his forces to a victory recorded only in the annals of his Chapter and the records of the Ordo Malleus. It was he who slew the Warboss of Waaagh! Gibrot in single combat, and he who led the assault on the Space Hulk Despoiler’s Bane that finally cleansed it of Genestealer taint. He is everything that a Space Marine should be, and yet, as all Absolvers do, he harbours secrets that few could guess at. So it was, when death came for him on his way to Baal, that Erinyes in some ways welcomed what was surely a fitting end for a true servant of the Emperor. In death, at least, his shame could finally end. But this was not to be. He awoke much later wreathed in the sterile, invasive apparatus of the Apothecarion.

Incapable of feeling fear, for a brief moment, a nameless sentiment animated his shattered form. In that instant, it seemed to Erinyes that all his life as a battle-brother had been a mere vision and that he was back on the operating table, a former neophyte having his Black Carapace installed and ascending to the rank of Space Marine. But it was not so. Eventually, a Tech-Priest greeted him and explained that his body was ruined and that, like the great Marneus Calgar before him, only crossing the Rubicon Primaris could be his salvation. Did he ascend?

How could he do otherwise? He put his doubts aside, recalled his oath to serve the Emperor onto death and, it seemed, beyond it, and embraced what it was he must become. So it was that Aureus Erinyes, Chapter Master of the Absolvers, was remade. But in the final moments, as genetic alchemy infused his shattered form with renewed strength, he experienced another vision akin to that which came to him when he had shed his humanity so long ago. In it, he saw Gilead Primus laid to waste by chittering xenos, proud Imperial Knights of Nethreus torn asunder by titanic alien forms, and the forges of Avachrus grow cold in the wake of uprising and invasion.

He saw the Great Devourer swallowing the system he had sworn to protect and knew he must return — by any means available to him, no matter how abhorrent.

Returned to Gilead at last, the Chapter Master has gathered his most trusted battle-brothers and those mortal servants recommended to him by those who stood by Gilead in his absence. He has yet to speak with Varonius, nor has he decided what to do about the situation on Trollius. Whatever agreement the Rogue Trader struck is no true Vow, but these are strange times. He has been remade, and the ancient rites of his Absolvers may need to be remade as well. He has heard reports that some refused to fight alongside the Primaris reinforcements, shunned what they saw as the blasphemy of meddling with the Emperor’s work, and refused to induct them as true Absolvers. Indeed the Chapter Master himself was troubled by what he had become, but as he battled through the accursed Webway, felt the new strength in his bones and slew his enemies with greater efficiency than ever before, he came to the realisation that this was the Emperor’s work in truth. His first decree was to extract a vow from every Absolver in the system to honour their brothers, whatever their form, so long as they served the Emperor and the Chapter both. The second was to renew the ancient Vow of Tygranas Dalir, to protect Gilead and its people, whatever the cost. In his dreams, in those fleeting minutes he allows his mind to sleep, Erinyes sees the teeth and claws of the Great Devourer at work in Gilead and knows this cost will be great.

options.name: Chapter Command
options.text:
Those members of the Absolvers chosen by Chapter Master Erinyes to serve as his agents in Gilead are honoured and burdened in equal measure. All know the Chapter Master’s reputation and that to serve him is to carry that reputation into Gilead. Failure is not an option, and death the only excuse.

Though an adherent to the Codex Astartes and somewhat bound by tradition, Erinyes has begun to open himself up to new approaches to old problems. In the face of the many demands placed upon him. He has in turn placed a great deal of trust in those who serve him. From learned Techmarines and powerful Librarians to ordinary battle-brothers, the Chapter Master has found new ways to utilise every tool at this disposal.

Impressed by the actions of Akahir, now 1st Company Lieutenant, in his temporary command of the Chapter, Erinyes is rumoured to be even considering expanding the more unorthodox missions undertaken in his absence. He has begun investigating every rumour and scrap of forgotten lore to be found in Gilead, ostensibly to identify threats yet to emerge.

His primary concern is dispatching powerful Agents to perils that have, up to now, been beyond the means of those who remained in Gilead. From careening Space Hulks to bastions of Chaos, few such hazards have escaped his sight, and his agents will find themselves pitted against some of the greatest threats the system faces.

note: Chapter Command (p.93) prints no LIMITATIONS, WARGEAR or BONUS boxes. Printed errors copied as printed (p.93): the fragment "In the face of the many demands placed upon him." and "at this disposal".
